steps.title: 12 Observe
steps.body: Read the stage timings and counts; define an alert for a sharp drop in documents_indexed.

steps.title: 13 Security
steps.body: Secrets in the secret store; none in code, images, or logs.

steps.title: 14 Handoff
steps.body: Runbook, architecture diagram, test results, and a maintenance plan draft for customer approval.

steps.title: 15 Clean up
steps.body: Tear down the disposable datasource or record why it stays. Remember that teardown cannot be undone. Revoke lab secrets.
